fields.narrative_intro: *A triumphant person and a cringing person discuss the Google DeepMind shakeup at a pitch competition where every single team claims their product uses AI.*
fields.panel1:
[setup]
TRIUMPHANT PERSON: "Demis Hassabis just became Chair AND Alphabet Chief Scientist."
CRINGING PERSON: "So he got promoted by quitting?"
fields.panel2:
[build]
TRIUMPHANT PERSON: "AND Jeff Dean — 27 years, TensorFlow, all of it — is just... leaving."
CRINGING PERSON: "Both. On the same press release."
fields.panel3:
[pivot]
TRIUMPHANT PERSON: "Dean says he's starting a public benefit corporation to discover science."
CRINGING PERSON: "Sir, this is a pitch competition."
fields.panel4:
[silent reaction]
[Visual: The cringing person looks left at a startup booth reading 'AI FOR YOGA.' Then right at a booth reading 'AI FOR SOUP.' Then back at the stage where a banner says 'JEFF DEAN: DISCOVERING ALL OF SCIENCE.' Their eye twitches.]
fields.panel5:
[punch]
CRINGING PERSON: "Every team here also claims they use AI."
TRIUMPHANT PERSON: "Only one of them co-wrote MapReduce."
fields.panel6:
[button]
[Visual: The soup AI booth has quietly added a second banner reading 'CO-FOUNDED BY SANJAY GHEMAWAT (NOT AFFILIATED).' Sanjay is visibly not there.]

narrative_summary: The joke plays on the absurdity of Dean and Hassabis's galaxy-brained departures landing in the same press release, contrasted with a pitch-competition full of trivial AI products, culminating in the soup-AI booth desperately name-dropping Sanjay Ghemawat.
rationale: Candidate 2 earns top marks across the board by weaponizing the most specific real details — MapReduce, TensorFlow, Sanjay Ghemawat, the 'discovering all of science' grandiosity — against the pitch-competition backdrop with genuine escalating absurdity. The button panel's 'NOT AFFILIATED' banner on the soup-AI booth is a genuinely earned visual punchline that doesn't just restate the setup, it adds a new layer of desperation that closes the loop perfectly.
story_title: Changes at Google DeepMind: Demis Hassabis from CEO to Chair, Jeff Dean departs
place: at a pitch competition where every single team claims their product uses AI
hat_pair: foam fire extinguisher hat with a dangling pull pin
foam bowling ball worn as a helmet with three finger holes arranged as a shocked face
